scenarios.name: Close a width-compacted panel by switching ribbon tabs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full View ribbon displayed
the narrow window shows Windows as a compact panel button
the temporary Windows panel is open
the user selects the visible Tools tab
the Tools ribbon groups are displayed
the user selects View from the tab overflow menu
the View ribbon groups are displayed
the temporary Windows panel remains closed
